details.detail: Sidewall panels and seams. Satin white with a joint every second window, clean in s01, s02, s05, s09 and q16. Still plain where tt_window shows a fine linen-like weave, and neutral white where the photos read warm off-white (lighting).

F/J bowl geometry. Short bowl, width, smooth sides and pill under the opening match tt_window and ml_DSC_1920. The pill is a little small: 22 x 46 mm, where tt_window scales to ~28-30 x ~52 mm against the 0.254 m pane. It reads as a thin outline in ra_fWin and s09 rather than tt_window's bold pill.

PY/Y full-height tub and raised bezel. The profile matches sp_py14 and py_37303. The crown darkening is now mild (0.55 of the pier) but still visible as a thin grey arc at aisle distance. The opening aspect is 0.69 against 0.66 in sp_py24, and the corner radius is right.
Recess tonal modelling and colour. The grade is right. The bowl is neutral, s 0.013, against s 0.13-0.23 in the photos (lighting).
Pane tunnel lining and seal rim. Lining/bowl is now 0.66 (w10 0.51), which matches tt_window at 0.68. The pane now reads as a light tunnel, as in the photo. Helps.
Electric shades. The LED colour is right, and the blackout is back to 0.63 of the wall. Pleats are crisp up close, and the mid-distance moire persists.

Manual PY/Y shades: stowed band, half and closed (win_front, s08). Unchanged. In s08 the closed shade (#cbc6bb) is hard to tell from the bezel at aisle distance, but the photos show the same (sp_py24).
Dado, air-return grilles and placards. Dado/wall is 0.42 in ra_dadoY against 0.44 in py_37303. The hue is slate (B-R +19 against +28). The grille layout matches win_low.
Carpets and Y seat-track covers. The q16 aisle is (44,53,75) against y_47303 (36,42,67), so the navy is right with a touch more lift. F/J are unchanged.

Door cross-aisle / galley vinyl. The cloudy mottle is still there and slightly flatter after lighting. It is a touch cool, (106,104,110) against sans_09 (106,100,103). The door-bay carpet is (69,60,50): it matches sans_09's bay (70,62,55), while lalf_134 shows a neutral charcoal (69,66,67).

Type A door surround and viewing window. The window sits forward of the grip, beside the arc's arrowhead, as in lalf_133/134. It is narrower than the photos: pane + reveal aspect ~0.39 against ~0.52 in lalf_134. It lacks the photo's bright cream bezel with the sliding-shade tab at the top. The lining renders neutral grey-white (192,191,190), B/R 0.99, where lalf_134 is warm cream (176,174,163), B/R 0.93 (lighting on MAT.door #e4dccb).

notes: w11 against w10. Shell code changes since the w10 renders (220b46f): stop fittings removed and a 5 mm blackout zig-zag.
